title: 🙏 Come Just As You Are
subtitle: Pull up a chair, dear. This one's simple.

intro.title: A Simple Place to Begin
paragraphs: You don't have to be perfect to talk with the Lord. You don't need fancy words, a quiet room, or your life all tidied up first. Just pray, and let Him guide you to the next step. He's been waiting to hear from you.

verses.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

blocks.title: A Thought to Carry With You
paragraphs: Start where you are. He'll take it from there. ☕

footer.heading: A Quiet Moment With the Lord
footer.text: You can come to Him just as you are.

card.title: Come Just As You Are
card.summary: A gentle reminder that prayer can begin right where you are, with the words you have.

seo.title: Come Just As You Are - Geeky Grands
seo.description: A gentle devotional about coming to God in prayer as you are, with KJV verses on grace, trust, and prayer.
